newsitem.title: UK: Stakis buys hotel from Pilkington.
newsitem.headline: Stakis buys hotel from Pilkington.

text.p: Stakis Plc on Tuesday said it acquired a hotel from the property subsidiary of Pilkington Plc in St. Helen's, Lancashire for 5.5 million stg.
The four star Chalon Court Hotel will be renamed the Stakis St Helen's Hotel. The freehold property includes 84 guest rooms, conference and banqueting facilities for up to 220 and a leisure club.

"It is our intention to upgrade the existing conference facilities and restaurant and bar areas over the next year as part of our capital investment programme," Stakis chief executive David Michels said in a statement.
With the acquisition, Stakis now has 46 hotels.
